service: MRNF ArcGIS MapServer Territoire/AQ_ADRESSES_WMS, layer 0 'Adresses' (Adresses Québec address points; native WKID 102100), queried by civic number and street with outSR=4326
position_attribute_note: The single record's outSR=4326 geometry lies 1.11 m from its Position attribute pair, consistent with a NAD83-to-WGS84 datum shift. The service geometry is used unchanged.

imagery_check.note: Esri World Imagery export, 400 m square centred on the point (imagery date not stated): the point falls at the north-east end of a flat-roofed building complex of roughly 140 by 60 m with rooftop plant and a row of outdoor units along its south side, between rue Canadien and an adjacent storage yard; qualitative check only, it does not separate the building from its lot.

method: Published WGS84 output geometry of the single Adresses Québec record for 2525 rue Canadien, Drummondville (direct geometry); distances by pyproj 3.7.1 Geod (WGS84).
